class.name: AudioBusSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for the volume, mute and solo values of the audio buses.

method.name: get_bus_names
method.description: Returns the names of all buses that have an entry, in the order of the list: the buses of the layout first, then stored buses that the layout does not have.

method.name: get_bus_volume_db
method.description: Returns the pending volume of the bus [param bus] in decibels. For a bus of the layout without an entry, returns its value in [AudioServer]. Reports an error and returns [code]0.0[/code] if there is no such bus.

method.name: get_bus_volume_linear
method.description: Returns the pending volume of the bus [param bus] as a linear value: [code]1.0[/code] is 0 dB (100 %), [code]0.0[/code] is silence (-80 dB or lower). Useful for sliders in percent.

method.name: has_bus
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the bus [param bus] has an entry or exists in the current bus layout of [AudioServer], that is, if its values can be set.

method.name: is_bus_mute
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the bus [param bus] is muted in the pending settings.

method.name: is_bus_solo
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the bus [param bus] is in solo mode in the pending settings.

method.name: set_bus_mute
method.description: Mutes or unmutes the bus [param bus]. Reports an error if the bus has no entry and does not exist in the bus layout.

method.name: set_bus_solo
method.description: Sets the solo mode of the bus [param bus]. Reports an error if the bus has no entry and does not exist in the bus layout.

method.name: set_bus_volume_db
method.description: Sets the volume of the bus [param bus] in decibels, clamped to -80 dB … 24 dB (the range of the bus slider in the editor). If the bus exists in the layout but has no entry yet, an entry with its current values is added first. Reports an error if the bus has no entry and does not exist in the bus layout.

method.name: set_bus_volume_linear
method.description: Sets the volume of the bus [param bus] as a linear value ([code]1.0[/code] is 0 dB, [code]0.5[/code] is about -6 dB, [code]0.0[/code] or less is -80 dB). The value is stored in decibels, see [method set_bus_volume_db].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], a stored bus that the bus layout does not have is added to [AudioServer] at the end of the layout when the values are applied. If [code]false[/code], it is skipped with one warning per bus and session; its entry stays in the settings and in the file. Initialized from [member ProjectSettings.settings/audio/create_missing_buses] when the server is created, so the startup uses the project setting.
